title: Original Stainless Steel Salt or Pepper Grinder - Top Spice Mill with Ceramic Blades, Brushed Stainless Steel and Adjustable Coarseness By Pepper Grinder （Single Package）
description:
About this item
✅Premium Food Grade Glass and Stainless Steel Cap- Salt and pepper grinder with food grade transparent glass which is safe and user-friendly for easy refill. The stainless Steel grinder cap won't rust and is scratch-proof.
✅Perfect Your Cooking with Desired Coarseness- Salt grinder with adjustable ceramic rotor supporting more than 5 sizes of coarseness. You can grind Himalayan sea salt, peppercorn medley, herbs, or other spices you desire.
✅Refillable & Large Capacity - Pepper grinder holds 3/4 cup of salt, pepper, or spice, avoiding frequent refills. Its wide opening ensures that you fill spices easily. We care about design details to satisfy your need and convenience.
✅Lovely Kitchen Tools- EBACO’s Peppermill is a modern and classy addition to your kitchen. Perfect for a family meal or dinner party. Ideal gift for any occasion.
✅100% Customer Satisfaction Guarantee- We care about your satisfaction and we wanted to optimize your experience with our product.

I bought two, one for whole peppercorns and one for course sea salt, and they work great. Because they are grinders and not shakers, they don't work well with fine salt. Grinds from find to course with very little pressure.

I intentionally saught out a stainless steel grinder so that it could handle my Himalayan salt and could be (hand) washed with hot water to Sterilize. I've never submerged the entire thing in water, but when I cleaned it for the first time I missed the fact that the piece holding the grinding wheel is plastic. Well, four days ago, I went to use it in the usual fashion that I do, I was not rough with it, just went to grind my salt and the plastic part completely broke off. This is why I wanted an actual stainless steel model and wish I had realized that this product is only fashionably stainless steel, which is so infuriating! Not only did I lose a grinder for my salt and I'm very low income, but I lost about 1/8 cup of expensive salt. Ugh, I have experienced the quality of the products on Amazon deteriorate so much over the last few years and wish I William Sonoma money, but why do I HAVE to?? FYI, refund opp ended 3/16, so I'm just sol. Amazon lured us in in the early days with a really just product, then once all of the local stores closed or got bought by other large, greedy corporations, they no longer care what is sold as long as their board is racking in the bills. I hate that I still have to use Amazon occasionally, but I actively try to avoid them when possible because I have had to return so many products for their horrible quality.Excellent product as described; arrived by UPS who leave packages after post office address I use is closed, mostly. 2nd item in same order never arrives as Auburn ME UPS forgot P.O. closes at noon and they should leave packages in lobby; send photo to me; and I'll drive to get it. Amazon should educate its Sellers. And refund the 2nd item which has no way to contact seller. Walmart's WAY better and FedEx to home address always as promised.Doesn't work.
It didn't grind well the first time I used it, and then the second time when I was cooking furiously, it absolutely would not grind anything, of course 2 days after the return deadline. It seems to me that the cheap plastic gears inside are just too soft to grind the peppercorns What a waste of money!In order to use this pepper grinder, you have to remove the top chrome portion and then hold the unit upside down. Otherwise, the ground pepper will stay under the cap until you remove it and not totally end up on your food. In other words, there's an additional step needed. This pepper grinder could have been designed better. I threw it away and bought a more traditionally designed unit.Barely pushes any salt out, God forbid you're actually using it, and grind it over a pan that's evaporating moisture. Get this if you want to sit over your pan twisting for 4 minutes having to clear the opening every 20 seconds.Purchased this product in Aug 2024 and it is already not functioning. The rotating piece is loose and the grinder is not grabbing, the central black connector is cracked. Could you let me know about warranty please?I purchased one with the stainless grinder for salt. One week after the 30 day return window it started dispensing rust on my food. I cannot adjust the fineness , even with pliers. Very disappointed.Was so excited to receive this pepper grinder until I noticed the offset placement of the grinder mechanism. As I suspected, this results in a very uneven product. As you can see in the picture, while set to fine, the pepper ranges from fine to course. If that doesn't bother you, I was pleased with the rest of the product. The glass container is a nice size, easy to fill, and fits nicely in my hand. I also opted for this as the mechanism is all metal. Such a shame to use better materials, only to fall short on the construction. As this product will not provide an even grind, I will be returning and have already placed an order for the HexClad HexMill Pepper Grinder. More money, but hopefully it will be worth it.It looks very nice and has a heavy feel to it but it doesn't grind very well. You have to keep shaking it to get the peppercorns to fall into the burr grinding area to grind them. I am using a smaller peppercorn and it just doesn't perform very well, I would buy something else.Rather disappointed in this product. Bought three. One had a spring come out in the first week. The handle came loose on the second one yesterday rendering it useless. Today the plastic seperator in side broke a tooth and another spring came out.
